$$
\iint_S 1\,\mathrm{d}S

where $S$ is defined by $z=2 x + 2 y$ for $1\le x\le 2$ and $0\le y\le 2$." :question/worked-solution "For a surface $S$ defined by $z=g(x,y)$ with $(x,y)\in D,$ the surface integral of a scalar function $f(x,y,z)$ over $S$ is given by

$$
{∬}_{S}f(x,y,z)\,\text{d}S={∬}_{D}f(x,y,g(x,y))\sqrt{1+{(\frac{∂z}{∂x})}^{2}+{(\frac{∂z}{∂y})}^{2}}\,\text{d}A.
$$

For the partial derivatives, we have

$$
\frac{∂z}{∂x}=\frac{∂}{∂x}(2 x + 2 y)=2,
$$

and

$$
\frac{∂z}{∂y}=\frac{∂}{∂y}(2 x + 2 y)=2.
$$

Therefore, the surface integral can be evaluated as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∬}_{S}1\,\text{d}S & ={∬}_{D}f(x,y,g(x,y))\sqrt{1+{(\frac{∂z}{∂x})}^{2}+{(\frac{∂z}{∂y})}^{2}}\,\text{d}A\\ & ={∬}_{D}1\sqrt{1+\left(2\right)^{2}+\left(2\right)^{2}}\,\text{d}A\\ & ={∬}_{D}3\,\text{d}A\\ & =3{∬}_{D}\,\text{d}A\\ & =3\cdot\text{Area}(D)\\ & =3\cdot\left(2-\left(1\right)\right)\cdot\left(2-\left(0\right)\right)\\ & =3\cdot\left(1\right)\cdot\left(2\right)\\ & =6.\end{aligned}
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["efca1546-0a41-50f6-8cf2-c2773894182b"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "aa4b6d7a-30b0-5938-825b-8aa9bd3f0580" :answer/id #uuid "aa4b6d7a-30b0-5938-825b-8aa9bd3f0580" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "6" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "fa631a1e-b650-5899-ab31-004c8a3b3cf6" :answer/id #uuid "fa631a1e-b650-5899-ab31-004c8a3b3cf6" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "36" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "263bec6f-8fab-5a99-bce0-3bd6e2ee6c4f" :answer/id #uuid "263bec6f-8fab-5a99-bce0-3bd6e2ee6c4f" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "6 \sqrt{2}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "c43b536e-4696-5803-a535-e7756f41d100" :answer/id #uuid "c43b536e-4696-5803-a535-e7756f41d100" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "3 \sqrt{6}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "f8bd8410-2775-5436-81af-14aad8107cd1" :answer/id #uuid "f8bd8410-2775-5436-81af-14aad8107cd1" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "6 \sqrt{6}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "16ab3e89-4254-53dc-8788-c69f6a8e3476" :answer-field/id #uuid "16ab3e89-4254-53dc-8788-c69f6a8e3476" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["aa4b6d7a-30b0-5938-825b-8aa9bd3f0580" "fa631a1e-b650-5899-ab31-004c8a3b3cf6" "263bec6f-8fab-5a99-bce0-3bd6e2ee6c4f" "c43b536e-4696-5803-a535-e7756f41d100" "f8bd8410-2775-5436-81af-14aad8107cd1"] :answer-field/correct "f8bd8410-2775-5436-81af-14aad8107cd1" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "70de3dca-c539-516f-9ac7-21707e474aee" :question/id #uuid "70de3dca-c539-516f-9ac7-21707e474aee" :question/problem "Evaluate the surface integral

$$
{∬}_{S}f(x,y,z)\,\text{d}S={∬}_{D}f(x,y,g(x,y))\sqrt{1+{(\frac{∂z}{∂x})}^{2}+{(\frac{∂z}{∂y})}^{2}}\,\text{d}A.
